Subject: Vendor onboarding refresh & procurement portal preflight — approval gating for renewal

Hi Liam —

Following our renewal call last week, Acme's legal asked us to run a quick procurement preflight so the renewal + capacity uplift (Q4 seats + dedicated capacity) can flow smoothly through your portal. To avoid last-minute PO delays, can you confirm two items:

1) The procurement portal request ID we should attach to the evidence bundle (I think it was 98321 but wanted to confirm).
2) Who in procurement will be the final approver for third-party SOC2 evidence and vendor security attestation?

I've attached a short onboarding-evidence checklist that maps the typical portal fields to the files we provide (SOC2, data retention, KMS attestation, sample SLA). If you prefer, we can upload the package directly to your portal on your behalf and add the portal request ID to the DocuSign PO.

Next steps we propose:
- Once you confirm request ID and approver, we'll upload the evidence bundle to the portal and notify procurement (copying you).
- Ben will share the updated SOW redline for the term extension and seat uplift.
- Grace will schedule a 30-min handoff with your procurement team to walk the portal fields for the PO.

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can align timelines with your finance team (customer wants go-live by 2026-11-01).

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
+aisha@redwood.com

Thanks Aisha —

Confirming request ID 98321 is correct. Our procurement approver for vendor security & SOC2 evidence is Sara Bell (copied). A couple of portal-specific notes:

- The portal requires each evidence file to be tagged with a "jurisdiction" field; our finance team prefers US for contract evidence.
- For DocuSign, procurement needs the PO to reference the portal request ID and include the fixed-term dates (start/end) in the body of the PO — otherwise the approval stalls.
- We typically need an upload by EOD Wednesday to meet our internal turnaround for a 2-week approval window.

Sara — can you confirm you can be the approver and that a Wednesday upload aligns with your queue?

Liam
